none: PAS NLM-83DAD4: Roman Coin: Radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate commemorating Claudius II (268-270), issue of 270-271, Reece period 13. Chipped, and possibly with blundered legend on obverse. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [DIVO C]LAVIO. Reverse description: no detail discerned. Reverse inscription: [CONSECR]ATIO. Diameter: 15.1mm, Weight: 1.20gms, die axis: 6
